# Network360 Core Team

With this release, the Network360 Core Team is happy to include in this release a fix for an issue that occurred in Compare Networks when the analysis geography was a radius of a large population file and other fixes. 

# Fixes

### Compare Networks

Fixed an issue where an error appeared exporting the pdf or viewing the details in the Network Strength quadrant when the analysis geography consisted of a radius search for population file with zip codes from more than 15 states. Now, the results are available, and no error appears. 

### Settings 

###### Project Settings > Clients Tab

Fixed an issue on the Clients tab where the validation message requiring the user to enter a client name continued to display after the user entered the name.
